services: cup: image: ghcr.io/sergi0g/cup:latest container_name: cup # Optional restart: unless-stopped networks: - proxy command: -c /config/cup.json serve volumes: - /run/user/1002/podman/podman.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro - ${PODMAN_STORAGE_PATH}/.config/cup/cup.json:/config/cup.json healthcheck: test: - CMD - /cup - –version interval: 60s timeout: 10s retries: 3 start_period: 20s labels: - traefik.enable=true - traefik.http.services.cup.loadbalancer.server.port=8000 - traefik.http.routers.cup.rule=Host(${FQDN}) - traefik.http.routers.cup.entrypoints=websecure - traefik.http.routers.cup.tls.certresolver=myresolver

labels:
  - traefik.enable=true

  - traefik.http.services.cup.loadbalancer.server.port=8000

  # Router normal de Cup
  - traefik.http.routers.cup.rule=Host(`${FQDN}`)
  - traefik.http.routers.cup.entrypoints=websecure
  - traefik.http.routers.cup.tls.certresolver=myresolver

  # Router protegido de la API
  - traefik.http.routers.cup-api.rule=Host(`${FQDN}`) && Path(`/api/v3/json`)
  - traefik.http.routers.cup-api.entrypoints=websecure
  - traefik.http.routers.cup-api.tls.certresolver=myresolver
  - traefik.http.routers.cup-api.middlewares=cup-api-auth@file
  - traefik.http.routers.cup-api.service=cup

networks: proxy: external: true

7777/tcp ALLOW Anywhere SSH 7777/tcp (v6) ALLOW Anywhere (v6) SSH 80/tcp ALLOW Anywhere WEB ( HTTP ) 80/tcp (v6) ALLOW Anywhere (v6) WEB ( HTTP ) 443/tcp ALLOW Anywhere WEB ( HTTPS ) 443/tcp (v6) ALLOW Anywhere (v6) WEB ( HTTPS ) 443/udp ALLOW Anywhere WEB ( HTTPS ) 443/udp (v6) ALLOW Anywhere (v6) WEB ( HTTPS )

#!/usr/sbin/nft -f

flush ruleset

table inet filter {

chain input {
    type filter hook input priority 0; policy drop;

    # Loopback
    iif "lo" accept

    # Conexiones existentes
    ct state established,related accept

    # Tráfico inválido
    ct state invalid drop

    # Bloquear nuevas conexiones TCP cuando una IP
    # supera 10 SYN por segundo, con una ráfaga inicial de 20
    ct state new tcp flags syn \
        meter flood { ip saddr limit rate over 10/second burst 20 packets } \
        log prefix "NF-RATE-LIMIT: " counter drop

    # Servicios permitidos
    tcp dport 7777 accept
    tcp dport 80 accept
    tcp dport 443 accept

    # HTTP/3 / QUIC
    udp dport 443 accept

    # ICMP IPv4
    icmp type {
        echo-request,
        echo-reply,
        destination-unreachable,
        time-exceeded,
        parameter-problem
    } accept

    # ICMPv6
    icmpv6 type {
        echo-request,
        echo-reply,
        destination-unreachable,
        time-exceeded,
        parameter-problem,
        nd-router-solicit,
        nd-router-advert,
        nd-neighbor-solicit,
        nd-neighbor-advert
    } accept

    # Todo lo demás se registra y se contabiliza
    log prefix "NF-DROP: " limit rate 5/minute
    counter drop
}

chain forward {
    type filter hook forward priority 0; policy drop;

    counter drop
}

chain output {
    type filter hook output priority 0; policy accept;
}

}
